versions.short: The proposal would amend EU rules on road charges for heavy goods vehicles so that charges vary according to each vehicle's CO2 emission class, with clearer timing for when new vehicle groups must be classified and charged. It would give national authorities and toll providers at least 12 months to apply the changes for new vehicle groups. It would allow Member States to offer reduced rates or exemptions from infrastructure and user charges for zero-emission and low-emission vehicles within set limits and time periods. It would require certain vehicles currently in CO2 emission classes 1 or 2 to be reclassified under a tighter emissions reduction target for 2030, and it would set rules on evidence of emissions, vocational vehicles, retrofitted zero-emission vehicles and dual-fuel vehicles. It would also require the European Commission to assess by 30 June 2029 whether Member States could vary toll rates by trailer characteristics and how to determine emissions of retrofitted vehicles.
